ai-residue.chat-leakage.description: chat-session leakage: … -- delete it, then audit the surrounding prose
ai-residue.chat-leakage.fix: Delete the artifact, then re-read the surrounding paragraphs, which came from the same session.
ai-residue.chat-leakage.name: Delete chat-session leakage

ai-tells-agentic.formulaic-universal-hea.description: universal slogan: … -- title it with a noun phrase, or state one scoped fact
ai-tells-agentic.formulaic-universal-hea.fix: Name the section with a noun phrase, or scope the claim and state it as a sentence.
ai-tells-agentic.formulaic-universal-hea.name: Replace a universal slogan with a title

ai-tells-content-shape.adjective-per-nou.description: adjective spray: … adjectives per noun -- keep the ones that carry load
ai-tells-content-shape.adjective-per-nou.fix: Keep adjectives that change what the reader does; cut decoration.
ai-tells-content-shape.adjective-per-nou.name: Cut decorative modifiers

ai-tells-content-shape.durable-vocabular.fix: Replace with the concrete verb or noun.
ai-tells-content-shape.durable-vocabular.name: Use the concrete verb

ai-tells-content-shape.elegant-variation.description: elegant variation: repeat the noun; precision beats variety
ai-tells-content-shape.elegant-variation.fix: Pick one name and use it every time.
ai-tells-content-shape.elegant-variation.name: Repeat the noun

ai-tells-content-shape.epigram-closer-re.description: epigram closer: the paragraph or table above already carried the content
ai-tells-content-shape.epigram-closer-re.name: Judge whether a closing line adds a fact

ai-tells-content-shape.fabricated-citati.description: damaged citation: … -- verify the reference and strip the tracking junk
ai-tells-content-shape.fabricated-citati.fix: Strip the tracking parameters from the URL.
ai-tells-content-shape.fabricated-citati.name: Strip citation junk

ai-tells-content-shape.fabricated-citati.description: unverified citation: verify every reference you did not fetch yourself
ai-tells-content-shape.fabricated-citati.fix: Fetch each reference, or delete the claim that rests on it.
ai-tells-content-shape.fabricated-citati.name: Verify every reference you did not fetch yourself

ai-tells-content-shape.fake-specificity.description: fake specificity: … -- give the number or drop the quantifier
ai-tells-content-shape.fake-specificity.fix: Give the count, or delete the quantifier.
ai-tells-content-shape.fake-specificity.name: Give the number or drop the quantifier

ai-tells-content-shape.one-point-dilutio.description: one-point dilution: say it once; stop
ai-tells-content-shape.one-point-dilutio.fix: Delete each restatement after the first unless it carries a distinct required fact or purpose.
ai-tells-content-shape.one-point-dilutio.name: Say it once and stop

ai-tells-content-shape.over-writing-rema.description: over-writing: cut it to the behavior; move the decision to an ADR, spec, or commit
ai-tells-content-shape.over-writing-rema.fix: Cut to the behavior; move decision history to an ADR, spec, commit, or change record.
ai-tells-content-shape.over-writing-rema.name: Judge whether the reader acts differently for having read it

ai-tells-content-shape.padded-symmetry.description: padded symmetry: two sentences is a fine section
ai-tells-content-shape.padded-symmetry.fix: Delete the padding and let the section be short.
ai-tells-content-shape.padded-symmetry.name: Let a section be two sentences

ai-tells-content-shape.superficial-ing-a.description: superficial -ing analysis: … -- state it as a fact, or delete it
ai-tells-content-shape.superficial-ing-a.fix: State the claim as its own sentence, or delete the clause.
ai-tells-content-shape.superficial-ing-a.name: State the analysis as a fact or delete it

ai-tells-content-shape.textbook-connecto.description: textbook connectors: replace with the concrete relation, or delete
ai-tells-content-shape.textbook-connecto.fix: Delete the connectors; if the relation is real, rewrite so the sentences carry it.
ai-tells-content-shape.textbook-connecto.name: Do not open consecutive sentences on a textbook connector

ai-tells-content-shape.unasked-for-ratio.description: unasked-for rationale: delete the clause and keep the behavior, or move the reason to the commit
ai-tells-content-shape.unasked-for-ratio.fix: Delete the rationale and keep the behavior, or move the reason to the appropriate decision or change record.
ai-tells-content-shape.unasked-for-ratio.name: Delete the clause and keep the behavior

ai-tells-content-shape.vaporware-descrip.description: vaporware: cut the CLAIM, not the qualifier
ai-tells-content-shape.vaporware-descrip.fix: For current artifacts, delete an unsupported claim or keep only the documented opt-in behavior. For change, history, decisions, plans, and specifications, label the status and date or target explicitly instead of disguising it as current behavior.
ai-tells-content-shape.vaporware-descrip.name: Cut the claim, not the qualifier

ai-tells-figurative.colloquial-assessmen.description: colloquial assessment: … -- state the judgement and the evidence for it
ai-tells-figurative.colloquial-assessmen.fix: Name the criterion, then say which option meets it.
ai-tells-figurative.colloquial-assessmen.name: State the assessment directly

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-casts.description: figurative "casts": … -- state the doubt and what supports it
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-casts.fix: Name the observation, then the doubt it creates.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-casts.name: State the doubt or the effect

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-draws.description: figurative "draws": … -- name the source, or state the comparison directly
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-draws.fix: Cite the source, or state the two things and how they differ.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-draws.name: Name the source or the comparison

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-falls.description: figurative "falls": … -- name the shortfall, or say which set it belongs to
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-falls.fix: Give the number it misses by, or name the set and the owner.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-falls.name: Name the shortfall or the membership

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-lends.description: figurative "lends": … -- say what it adds, or what it makes possible
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-lends.fix: Name the property, or say what the reader can now do.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-lends.name: State what it adds or enables

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-loud.description: figurative "loud": … -- name what it actually does
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-loud.fix: Say which channel it writes to and at what level.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-loud.name: Name the behaviour, not the volume

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-rides.description: figurative "rides": … -- name what depends on what
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-rides.fix: State the dependency as a condition: X works only when Y holds.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-rides.name: Name the dependency or the mechanism

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-runs.description: figurative "runs": … -- name the behaviour, not the motion
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-runs.fix: State what happens, or which assumption the code actually makes.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-runs.name: Name the actual behaviour

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-sits.description: figurative "sits": … -- write the literal relation: is at, rests with, is unused
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-sits.fix: Replace with the literal relation, or delete the sentence if it carries no fact.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-sits.name: Name the literal relation

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-strikes.description: figurative "strikes": … -- state the effect or the tradeoff directly
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-strikes.fix: Name the effect, or the two things traded off and which one this takes.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-strikes.name: State the effect or the tradeoff

ai-tells-figurative.figurative-wins.description: figurative "wins": … -- state the benefit and its size
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-wins.fix: Replace the win with the measurement that makes it one.
ai-tells-figurative.figurative-wins.name: State the benefit or the outcome

ai-tells-figurative.resonate-overuse.description: figurative "resonate": … -- name what connects, and with whom
ai-tells-figurative.resonate-overuse.fix: State who agreed with what, or delete the sentence.
ai-tells-figurative.resonate-overuse.name: Name what connects and why

ai-tells-formatting.bold-spray.description: bold spray: … bold spans per 1000 words -- bold at most first definitional use
ai-tells-formatting.bold-spray.fix: Keep bold on the first definitional use of a term and delete the rest.
ai-tells-formatting.bold-spray.name: Bold at most the first definitional use

ai-tells-formatting.cross-reference-sign.description: cross-reference signposting: … -- delete it; a doc with a TOC is not read linearly
ai-tells-formatting.cross-reference-sign.fix: Delete the signpost, or link the named section.
ai-tells-formatting.cross-reference-sign.name: Delete the cross-reference signpost

ai-tells-formatting.em-dash-density.description: dash density: … dashes per 1000 words -- most become commas, colons, or two sentences
ai-tells-formatting.em-dash-density.fix: Convert each dash that is not marking a real aside into a comma, a colon, or two sentences.
ai-tells-formatting.em-dash-density.name: Keep only the em dashes that mark a real aside

ai-tells-formatting.emoji-list-markers.description: emoji list marker: … -- delete it; the list marker carries the structure
ai-tells-formatting.emoji-list-markers.fix: Delete the emoji; use a plain list marker.
ai-tells-formatting.emoji-list-markers.name: Delete emoji used as list markers

ai-tells-formatting.heading-hierarchy.description: heading hierarchy: … -- fix the level; delete the rule before it
ai-tells-formatting.heading-hierarchy.fix: Use the next level down, and delete any horizontal rule immediately before a heading.
ai-tells-formatting.heading-hierarchy.name: Fix a skipped heading level

ai-tells-formatting.inline-header-list.description: inline-header list: … consecutive bold-colon bullets -- prose, or a table with real columns
ai-tells-formatting.inline-header-list.fix: Rewrite as prose, or as a table when there are real columns.
ai-tells-formatting.inline-header-list.name: Convert a repeated bold-colon bullet run to prose or a table

ai-tells-formatting.italicised-copula.description: italicised copula: … -- delete the emphasis; let word order carry the contrast
ai-tells-formatting.italicised-copula.fix: Delete the emphasis; rewrite so word order carries the contrast if it is real.
ai-tells-formatting.italicised-copula.name: Delete manufactured emphasis

ai-tells-formatting.table-wrapping-one-s.fix: Unwrap the table into the sentence it holds.
ai-tells-formatting.table-wrapping-one-s.name: Unwrap a table that holds one sentence

ai-tells-formatting.title-case-heading.description: title-case heading: … -- use sentence case unless house style says otherwise
ai-tells-formatting.title-case-heading.fix: Lower-case every word but the first and any proper noun.
ai-tells-formatting.title-case-heading.name: Use sentence case in headings

ai-tells-register.anthropomorphised-just.description: anthropomorphised justification: … -- state the measured property
ai-tells-register.anthropomorphised-just.fix: State the measured property that would justify the claim.
ai-tells-register.anthropomorphised-just.name: State the measured property, not the desert

ai-tells-register.anthropomorphised-just.description: anthropomorphised justification: a component granted intent so its value needs no argument
ai-tells-register.anthropomorphised-just.fix: Replace the merit claim with the checkable property.
ai-tells-register.anthropomorphised-just.name: Judge whether a component is granted intent

ai-tells-register.corporate-analytic-fil.description: analytic filler: … -- delete the wrapper; keep the noun
ai-tells-register.corporate-analytic-fil.fix: Delete the wrapper and keep the noun it packaged.
ai-tells-register.corporate-analytic-fil.name: Delete the analysis wrapper and keep the noun

ai-tells-register.false-agency-remainder.description: false agency: name the human, or use "you" and put the reader in the seat
ai-tells-register.false-agency-remainder.fix: Name the human. Where no specific person fits, use "you" and put the reader in the seat.
ai-tells-register.false-agency-remainder.name: Judge whether an abstraction occupies the subject slot

ai-tells-register.faux-candor-core.description: faux candor: … -- cut the intimacy performance; candor is the unhedged claim
ai-tells-register.faux-candor-core.fix: Delete the frame and make the claim it was protecting.
ai-tells-register.faux-candor-core.name: Cut the intimacy performance

ai-tells-register.faux-candor-remainder.description: faux candor: candor is the unhedged claim itself
ai-tells-register.faux-candor-remainder.fix: Replace the performance with the specific admission and its cost.
ai-tells-register.faux-candor-remainder.name: Judge whether an admission carries risk

ai-tells-register.figurative-verb-verdic.description: figurative verdict: … -- state the judgement literally, with the observation that supports it
ai-tells-register.figurative-verb-verdic.fix: State the judgement as a claim, with the observation that supports it.
ai-tells-register.figurative-verb-verdic.name: State the judgement literally

ai-tells-register.figurative-verb-verdic.description: figurative verdict: the construction carries the verdict so no evidence has to
ai-tells-register.figurative-verb-verdic.fix: Replace the metaphor with the observation and the judgement it supports.
ai-tells-register.figurative-verb-verdic.name: Judge whether a metaphor carries a verdict with no evidence

ai-tells-register.hedged-symmetry.description: hedged symmetry: take the position the evidence supports; cut the ballast
ai-tells-register.hedged-symmetry.fix: Delete the invented counter-claim and state the position the evidence supports.
ai-tells-register.hedged-symmetry.name: Take the position the evidence supports

ai-tells-register.intensifier-tics-core.description: intensifier tic: … -- drop it; add the specific claim that would justify it
ai-tells-register.intensifier-tics-core.fix: Delete the adverb and add the claim that would have justified it.
ai-tells-register.intensifier-tics-core.name: Drop the unearned intensifier

ai-tells-register.intensifier-tics-remai.description: unearned emotion: add the specific claim, or drop the adverb
ai-tells-register.intensifier-tics-remai.fix: Supply the support, or delete the adverb.
ai-tells-register.intensifier-tics-remai.name: Judge whether emotion is announced or earned

ai-tells-register.organic-consequence-co.description: organic-consequence framing: … -- say the choice was made, and who made it
ai-tells-register.organic-consequence-co.fix: Name the person who chose it and the constraint that drove the choice.
ai-tells-register.organic-consequence-co.name: Say the choice was made, and why

ai-tells-register.organic-consequence-re.description: organic-consequence framing: a designed decision presented as something that happened
ai-tells-register.organic-consequence-re.fix: Name the chooser and the reason.
ai-tells-register.organic-consequence-re.name: Judge whether a design is presented as self-caused

ai-tells-register.over-formatting-reflex.description: over-formatting: format only when the data has columns or the items are parallel and independent
ai-tells-register.over-formatting-reflex.fix: Unwrap the structure into prose where the items are neither columnar nor independent.
ai-tells-register.over-formatting-reflex.name: Format only when the data has columns

ai-tells-register.sycophantic-meta-resid.description: sycophancy residue: … -- delete it, then audit the surrounding text
ai-tells-register.sycophantic-meta-resid.fix: Delete the phrase, then re-read the surrounding prose, which came from the same session.
ai-tells-register.sycophantic-meta-resid.name: Delete the approval residue and audit the surrounding text

ai-tells-register.urgency-inflation-core.description: urgency inflation: … -- name what breaks if the reader ignores it, or drop the framing
ai-tells-register.urgency-inflation-core.fix: Name the consequence, or delete the framing.
ai-tells-register.urgency-inflation-core.name: Name what breaks, or drop the framing

ai-tells-register.urgency-inflation-rema.description: urgency inflation: name what breaks if the reader ignores it
ai-tells-register.urgency-inflation-rema.fix: State the failure mode, or delete the urgency.
ai-tells-register.urgency-inflation-rema.name: Judge whether stakes name a consequence

ai-tells-structure.absolute-assertion-co.description: absolute assertion: … -- state the claim with its actual scope
ai-tells-structure.absolute-assertion-co.name: State the claim with its actual scope

ai-tells-structure.absolute-assertion-re.description: absolute assertion: state the claim with its actual scope
ai-tells-structure.absolute-assertion-re.fix: Narrow the claim to the scope the evidence supports.
ai-tells-structure.absolute-assertion-re.name: Judge whether an absolute claim survives one counterexample

ai-tells-structure.analogy-stack-authori.description: analogy stack: one apt comparison, or none
ai-tells-structure.analogy-stack-authori.fix: Keep the one comparison that shares a mechanism with the subject, or cut all of them.
ai-tells-structure.analogy-stack-authori.name: Keep one apt comparison, or none

ai-tells-structure.anaphora-abuse.description: anaphora: say it once; merge the objects
ai-tells-structure.anaphora-abuse.fix: Write the subject-verb once and list the objects.
ai-tells-structure.anaphora-abuse.name: Say it once and merge the objects

ai-tells-structure.audience-straddle-cor.description: audience straddle: … -- write for the one audience the doc has
ai-tells-structure.audience-straddle-cor.fix: Pick the audience the document has and write for it.
ai-tells-structure.audience-straddle-cor.name: Write for the one audience the doc has

ai-tells-structure.audience-straddle-rem.description: audience straddle: write for the one audience the doc has
ai-tells-structure.audience-straddle-rem.fix: Pick the audience for the task and cut material that cannot help complete it.
ai-tells-structure.audience-straddle-rem.name: Judge whether the document holds one audience

ai-tells-structure.cataphoric-lead-in-co.description: cataphoric lead-in: … -- let the list carry its own length; cut the forecast
ai-tells-structure.cataphoric-lead-in-co.fix: Delete the count and let the list carry its own length.
ai-tells-structure.cataphoric-lead-in-co.name: Cut the count forecast

ai-tells-structure.cataphoric-lead-in-re.fix: Delete the forecast unless the reader must budget effort before reading.
ai-tells-structure.cataphoric-lead-in-re.name: Judge whether a forecast tells the reader anything

ai-tells-structure.contrastive-inversion.description: contrastive inversion: … -- state what the thing is; cut the strawman
ai-tells-structure.contrastive-inversion.fix: Delete the negated half and state what the thing is.
ai-tells-structure.contrastive-inversion.name: Cut the strawman half of a contrastive frame

ai-tells-structure.contrastive-inversion.description: contrastive inversion: state what the thing is; cut the strawman
ai-tells-structure.contrastive-inversion.name: Judge whether a contrast names a real alternative

ai-tells-structure.definitional-negation.description: definitional contrast across sentences: … -- state what the thing is once; cut the invented alternative
ai-tells-structure.definitional-negation.fix: Keep the sentence that says what the thing is; delete the one that says what it is not, unless the negated half states an independent fact a reader would otherwise assume.
ai-tells-structure.definitional-negation.name: Cut a cross-sentence definitional contrast

ai-tells-structure.false-range.description: false range: list the actual items, or name the real dimension
ai-tells-structure.false-range.fix: List the items, or name the dimension that actually varies.
ai-tells-structure.false-range.name: List the actual items or name the real dimension

ai-tells-structure.false-suspense-frames.description: false suspense: … -- delete the drumroll; state the point
ai-tells-structure.false-suspense-frames.fix: Delete the phrase and state the point.
ai-tells-structure.false-suspense-frames.name: Delete the drumroll

ai-tells-structure.false-suspense-remain.description: false suspense: delete the drumroll; state the point
ai-tells-structure.false-suspense-remain.fix: Delete the transition and open on the point.
ai-tells-structure.false-suspense-remain.name: Judge whether a transition withholds the point

ai-tells-structure.fragment-question-piv.name: Replace a question-answer fragment pair with a declarative

ai-tells-structure.heading-echo.description: heading echo: start with the first new fact
ai-tells-structure.heading-echo.fix: Delete the restatement and open on the first new fact.
ai-tells-structure.heading-echo.name: Start with the first new fact after a heading

ai-tells-structure.hollow-acknowledgment.description: hollow acknowledgment: solve it, or cut the paragraph that raises it
ai-tells-structure.hollow-acknowledgment.fix: State the action, or delete the paragraph.
ai-tells-structure.hollow-acknowledgment.name: Solve it, or cut the paragraph that raises it

ai-tells-structure.invented-concept-labe.description: invented concept label: use the plain description; coin nothing
ai-tells-structure.invented-concept-labe.fix: Replace the coinage with the plain description.
ai-tells-structure.invented-concept-labe.name: Coin nothing

ai-tells-structure.listicle-in-a-trench-.description: listicle in prose: either a real list, or prose with connective logic
ai-tells-structure.listicle-in-a-trench-.fix: Convert to a list, or rewrite as prose where each paragraph follows from the last.
ai-tells-structure.listicle-in-a-trench-.name: Make it a real list or real prose

ai-tells-structure.meta-narration-frames.description: meta-narration: … -- delete it; navigation is the TOC's job
ai-tells-structure.meta-narration-frames.fix: Delete the sentence; the table of contents carries navigation.
ai-tells-structure.meta-narration-frames.name: Delete the navigation announcement

ai-tells-structure.meta-narration-remain.description: meta-narration: delete it; navigation is the TOC's job
ai-tells-structure.meta-narration-remain.fix: Delete the navigation sentence; retain the fact, constraint, or purpose it was masking.
ai-tells-structure.meta-narration-remain.name: Judge whether a sentence spends itself on navigation

ai-tells-structure.negative-inventory-co.description: negative inventory: … -- state the supported behavior or constraint
ai-tells-structure.negative-inventory-co.fix: State the actionable behavior, enforced constraint, or reproducible result; delete the inventory otherwise.
ai-tells-structure.negative-inventory-co.name: Cut low-value negative inventory

ai-tells-structure.negative-inventory-re.description: negative inventory: state the supported behavior or constraint
ai-tells-structure.negative-inventory-re.fix: Keep the actionable boundary or result and delete inventory narration.
ai-tells-structure.negative-inventory-re.name: Judge whether a negative constraint is actionable

ai-tells-structure.rhetorical-question-t.description: rhetorical question: … -- answer directly; delete the question
ai-tells-structure.rhetorical-question-t.fix: Delete the question and state the answer.
ai-tells-structure.rhetorical-question-t.name: Answer directly instead of asking

ai-tells-structure.staccato-negative-par.description: staccato negative parallel: … -- one plain sentence naming the thing
ai-tells-structure.staccato-negative-par.fix: Write one declarative sentence naming what the thing is.
ai-tells-structure.staccato-negative-par.name: Replace a staccato negative run with one sentence

ai-tells-structure.staccato-negative-par.description: fragment cadence: rejoin the fragments and let the fact carry the weight
ai-tells-structure.staccato-negative-par.fix: Rejoin the fragments into one or two sentences.
ai-tells-structure.staccato-negative-par.name: Judge whether a fragment run carries content

ai-tells-structure.summary-closer-frames.description: summary closer: … -- end on the last fact
ai-tells-structure.summary-closer-frames.fix: Delete the closer; the last fact ends the section.
ai-tells-structure.summary-closer-frames.name: End on the last fact

ai-tells-structure.summary-closer-remain.description: summary closer: end on the last fact
ai-tells-structure.summary-closer-remain.name: Judge whether a closing section adds a fact

ai-tells-structure.think-of-it-as-core.description: teacher voice: … -- explain the actual mechanism once; cut the teacher voice
ai-tells-structure.think-of-it-as-core.fix: State the mechanism once and delete the analogy.
ai-tells-structure.think-of-it-as-core.name: Explain the mechanism instead of the metaphor

ai-tells-structure.think-of-it-as-remain.description: teacher voice: explain the actual mechanism once
ai-tells-structure.think-of-it-as-remain.fix: State the mechanism; keep the analogy only if it shortens the explanation.
ai-tells-structure.think-of-it-as-remain.name: Judge whether an analogy replaces the mechanism

ai-tells-structure.tricolon-abuse-core.description: tricolon: … -- cut to the one or two that carry load; break the symmetry
ai-tells-structure.tricolon-abuse-core.fix: Keep the one or two items that carry load and break the symmetry.
ai-tells-structure.tricolon-abuse-core.name: Cut a three-item list to the items that carry load

ai-tells-structure.tricolon-abuse-remain.description: parallel symmetry: keep only the items with distinct substance
ai-tells-structure.tricolon-abuse-remain.fix: Merge into prose, or keep only the items with distinct substance.
ai-tells-structure.tricolon-abuse-remain.name: Judge whether parallel bullets carry distinct substance

ai-tells-structure.vague-attribution-cor.description: vague attribution: … -- name the source or own the claim
ai-tells-structure.vague-attribution-cor.fix: Name the source with a citation, or state the claim in your own voice.
ai-tells-structure.vague-attribution-cor.name: Name the source or own the claim

ai-tells-structure.vague-attribution-rem.description: vague attribution: name the source or own the claim
ai-tells-structure.vague-attribution-rem.fix: Add the citation, or restate the claim as your own.
ai-tells-structure.vague-attribution-rem.name: Judge whether a cited source is checkable

docs-discipline.history-narration.description: history narration: … -- deltas belong in change comms, not a doc body
docs-discipline.history-narration.fix: Delete the delta; a changelog or release note carries it.
docs-discipline.history-narration.name: Keep deltas out of a doc body

docs-discipline.internal-refs.description: internal reference: … -- consumer docs describe the released artifact only
docs-discipline.internal-refs.fix: State the behaviour; drop the pointer to internal process.
docs-discipline.internal-refs.name: Keep internal references out of consumer docs

docs-discipline.status-language.description: status language: … -- state what the artifact does at HEAD
docs-discipline.status-language.fix: Delete the passage, or state the behaviour the code has now.
docs-discipline.status-language.name: State what the artifact does at HEAD

orwell.concrete-floor.description: This paragraph makes a factual claim with no checkable particular.
orwell.concrete-floor.fix: Replace the category with the instance from the source material.
orwell.concrete-floor.name: Name a checkable particular

orwell.stale-figure.description: "…" is a worn figure. State the fact it stands in for.
orwell.stale-figure.fix: Delete the figure and state the underlying fact.
orwell.stale-figure.name: Cut the stale figure

orwell.unsupported-evaluative.description: "…" evaluates without evidence. Add the number, or cut the word.
orwell.unsupported-evaluative.fix: Delete the adjective and state the fact that motivated it.
orwell.unsupported-evaluative.name: Back the adjective or cut it

prose-agency.agentless-passive.fix: Put the actor in the subject slot.
prose-agency.agentless-passive.name: Name who acted in a passive

prose-agency.anthropomorphism.description: anthropomorphism: … -- name the mechanism, not a mind
prose-agency.anthropomorphism.fix: Replace the cognition verb with the mechanism -- matches, requires, selects, branches.
prose-agency.anthropomorphism.name: Name the mechanism, not a mind

prose-agency.false-agency.fix: Name the human, or use "you" and put the reader in the seat.
prose-agency.false-agency.name: Name who acted

prose-agency.narrator-distance.description: narrator-from-a-distance: … -- put the reader in the scene, or name who acted
prose-agency.narrator-distance.fix: Name the actor, or address the reader directly with a concrete action.
prose-agency.narrator-distance.name: Put the reader in the scene

prose-agency.unattributed-recommendation.description: unattributed recommendation: … -- name who recommends it, or give the instruction
prose-agency.unattributed-recommendation.fix: Name the recommender, or drop the frame and give the instruction.
prose-agency.unattributed-recommendation.name: Name who recommends it

prose-craft.ambiguity.description: ambiguous: … -- pick the reading you meant
prose-craft.ambiguity.fix: State the reading you meant -- "a and b", "a or b", or "a, b, or both".
prose-craft.ambiguity.name: Pick the reading you meant

prose-craft.articles.description: article: use '…' instead of '…' (the article follows pronunciation)
prose-craft.articles.fix: Use the article the initialism's spoken form takes.
prose-craft.articles.name: Match the article to the initialism's pronunciation

prose-craft.command-prompt.description: shell prompt: … -- drop the prompt so the command can be copied
prose-craft.command-prompt.fix: Show the command alone; name the shell in the fence's language tag if it matters.
prose-craft.command-prompt.name: Drop the shell prompt from a command

prose-craft.conflict-markers.description: merge conflict marker: … -- resolve the conflict
prose-craft.conflict-markers.fix: Resolve the conflict and delete the markers.
prose-craft.conflict-markers.name: Resolve the merge conflict

prose-craft.dead-opener.description: dead opener: … -- start the sentence with its real subject
prose-craft.dead-opener.fix: Move the real subject into the subject slot.
prose-craft.dead-opener.name: Start the sentence with its real subject

prose-craft.directional-ref.description: directional reference: use '…' instead of '…', or link the heading by name
prose-craft.directional-ref.fix: Name or link the target section, table, or element.
prose-craft.directional-ref.name: Link the heading by name instead of by position

prose-craft.first-person-plural.description: first-person plural: … -- name the artifact instead of the vendor
prose-craft.first-person-plural.fix: Put the artifact in the subject slot.
prose-craft.first-person-plural.name: Name the artifact, not the vendor

prose-craft.future-tense.description: future tense: … -- describe what it does now
prose-craft.future-tense.fix: Put the verb in the present tense.
prose-craft.future-tense.name: Describe what it does now

prose-craft.gerund-heading.description: gerund heading: … -- use the imperative ('Install', not 'Installing')
prose-craft.gerund-heading.fix: Rewrite the heading in the imperative.
prose-craft.gerund-heading.name: Use the imperative in a task heading

prose-craft.hyphens.description: adverb hyphen: … -- an -ly adverb takes no hyphen
prose-craft.hyphens.name: Drop the hyphen after an -ly adverb

prose-craft.link-text.description: link text: … -- name the destination in the link text
prose-craft.link-text.fix: Replace the label with the target's name.
prose-craft.link-text.name: Name the destination in the link text

prose-craft.misnomer.description: misnomer: … -- the initialism already contains that word
prose-craft.misnomer.name: Drop the word the initialism already contains

prose-craft.negative-requirement.description: negative requirement: … -- state what is required, not what is forbidden
prose-craft.negative-requirement.fix: Invert the sentence to state the requirement.
prose-craft.negative-requirement.name: State what is required

prose-craft.ordinals.description: ordinal: … -- use 'first', or let the list carry the order
prose-craft.ordinals.fix: Use "first", or drop the ordinal and let the list marker carry it.
prose-craft.ordinals.name: Write the word ordinal, or let the list carry the order

prose-craft.plural-abbreviation.name: Drop the apostrophe from a plural initialism

prose-craft.politeness.description: politeness: … -- an instruction is not a request; state the step
prose-craft.politeness.fix: Delete the courtesy word and state the step.
prose-craft.politeness.name: State the step, not a request

prose-craft.relative-date.description: relative date: … -- give the absolute date or version
prose-craft.relative-date.fix: Give the absolute date or the version number.
prose-craft.relative-date.name: Give the absolute date or version

prose-craft.self-reference.description: self-reference: … -- the heading already says this; start with the first new fact
prose-craft.self-reference.name: Start with the first new fact

prose-craft.sentence-length.description: sentence of … words > 34 -- split it, or convert the enumeration to a list
prose-craft.sentence-length.fix: Split the sentence, or turn the enumeration into a list.
prose-craft.sentence-length.name: Split a long sentence

prose-craft.spacing.description: sentence spacing: … -- use exactly one space after the period
prose-craft.spacing.name: Use one space after a period

prose-craft.unclear-antecedent.description: unclear antecedent: … -- name the noun the demonstrative points at
prose-craft.unclear-antecedent.fix: Add the noun after the demonstrative.
prose-craft.unclear-antecedent.name: Name the noun the demonstrative points at

prose-discipline.bare-quantifier-with-fi.description: A bare quantifier stands where a figure was available. Give the number.
prose-discipline.bare-quantifier-with-fi.fix: Replace the quantifier with the figure. Where the set is genuinely unmeasured, say so and name why.
prose-discipline.bare-quantifier-with-fi.name: Give the bare quantifier its number

prose-discipline.bidirectional-hedge.description: "…" hedges in both directions, so the two halves cancel. State which one the evidence supports.
prose-discipline.bidirectional-hedge.fix: Keep the direction the evidence supports and state its magnitude. Where both hold, give both numbers rather than both hedges.
prose-discipline.bidirectional-hedge.name: Do not hedge both ways

prose-discipline.competing-actor-terms.description: Two or more terms name what may be the same subject. Pick one and use it everywhere, or state the distinction at first use.
prose-discipline.competing-actor-terms.fix: Choose the narrowest accurate term, replace every other, and define the distinction at first use only when two subjects genuinely differ.
prose-discipline.competing-actor-terms.name: Pick one term for one subject

prose-discipline.frozen-verb.description: "…" freezes the action in a noun. Use the plain verb.
prose-discipline.frozen-verb.fix: Promote the noun to a finite verb and delete the general-purpose verb and its article.
prose-discipline.frozen-verb.name: Put the action in the verb

prose-discipline.hedged-hedge.description: "…" hedges a hedge. Keep at most one, or state the claim plainly.
prose-discipline.hedged-hedge.fix: Delete the hedging verbs and the quantifier, then name what actually changes.
prose-discipline.hedged-hedge.name: One hedge or none

prose-discipline.hedged-into-uselessness.description: This document hedges its own claims to the point of asserting nothing. Take the position the evidence supports.
prose-discipline.hedged-into-uselessness.fix: For each hedged claim, either state it plainly with the evidence, or delete it. Where the uncertainty is real, name its cause and its bound instead of hedging the verb.
prose-discipline.hedged-into-uselessness.name: The document must assert something

prose-discipline.marketing-lexicon.description: "…" is sales register. State the measurable fact instead.
prose-discipline.marketing-lexicon.fix: Delete the adjective and state what the reader can measure.
prose-discipline.marketing-lexicon.name: Cut the marketing adjective

prose-discipline.marketing-register.description: This passage sells rather than describes. State what the artifact does and what a reader can measure.
prose-discipline.marketing-register.fix: Replace each unmeasurable claim with the fact that motivated it, or delete the sentence.
prose-discipline.marketing-register.name: Describe, do not sell

prose-discipline.overloaded-sentence.description: This sentence carries more than one idea. Split it at the point where the reader has to start holding something new.
prose-discipline.overloaded-sentence.fix: Split at the boundary where the reader starts holding a second thing, and make the shared noun explicit in the new sentence.
prose-discipline.overloaded-sentence.name: One sentence, one idea

prose-discipline.phrasal-verb.fix: Replace with the plain verb the list names.
prose-discipline.phrasal-verb.name: Use the plain verb

prose-discipline.run-on.description: This sentence stitches … independent ideas together; the limit is …. Split it.
prose-discipline.run-on.fix: Split at the clause boundary that carries the least shared context.
prose-discipline.run-on.name: Split the run-on

prose-format.emoji-heading.fix: Delete the emoji; the heading text carries the meaning.
prose-format.emoji-heading.name: Delete emoji from a heading

prose-format.no-unicode-dash.description: em/en dash: … -- write `--` instead, or a comma, colon, or two sentences
prose-format.no-unicode-dash.fix: Replace with `--`, a comma, a colon, or two sentences. For a range, write "to".
prose-format.no-unicode-dash.name: Write ASCII double-hyphen instead of an em or en dash

prose-format.prose-block.description: prose block of … words > … strings a series through three or more sentences -- convert to a list or table
prose-format.prose-block.fix: Split the paragraph, or turn the enumeration into a list or a table.
prose-format.prose-block.name: Convert a long paragraph to a list or table

prose-inclusive.ableist.fix: Use the plainer word that was meant.
prose-inclusive.ableist.name: Replace a disability metaphor with the plainer word

prose-inclusive.device-assumption.name: Do not assume the reader's input device

prose-inclusive.exclusive.name: Replace an exclusionary term with its settled form

prose-inflation.additive-hedge.description: additive hedge: … -- keep the claim that carries load
prose-inflation.additive-hedge.fix: Keep the half that carries the claim; delete the negation.
prose-inflation.additive-hedge.name: Keep the claim that carries load

prose-inflation.apologizing.description: deferred claim: … -- answer it, or cut the passage that raises it
prose-inflation.apologizing.fix: Answer the question, or delete the passage that raises it.
prose-inflation.apologizing.name: Answer the question or cut the passage

prose-inflation.borderline-hype.description: borderline hype: … -- keep it only if a number or example backs it
prose-inflation.borderline-hype.fix: Delete the word, or add the number or example that justifies it.
prose-inflation.borderline-hype.name: Back the claim with a number or example

prose-inflation.business-jargon.description: business jargon: … -- use the plain verb
prose-inflation.business-jargon.fix: Use the plain verb -- "double down" is "commit", "circle back" is "return to".
prose-inflation.business-jargon.name: Use the plain verb

prose-inflation.document-preamble.description: preamble: … -- the title already says this; start with the first fact
prose-inflation.document-preamble.fix: Delete the sentence; the document starts on its first fact.
prose-inflation.document-preamble.name: Start with the first fact

prose-inflation.hedge-stack.description: stacked hedge: … -- one hedge or none; commit to the claim or cut it
prose-inflation.hedge-stack.fix: Keep one hedge or none; commit to the claim or cut it.
prose-inflation.hedge-stack.name: One hedge or none

prose-inflation.intensifier.description: intensifier: … -- delete it, or replace the adjective with a number
prose-inflation.intensifier.fix: Delete the adverb, or replace the adjective with a measurement.
prose-inflation.intensifier.name: Delete the degree adverb

prose-inflation.nominalized-verb.description: nominalisation: … -- use the verb ('validate', not 'perform validation')
prose-inflation.nominalized-verb.fix: Move the action back into the verb slot.
prose-inflation.nominalized-verb.name: Use the verb, not the noun

prose-inflation.slop-lexicon.description: slop lexicon: … -- delete it or replace it with a measurable claim
prose-inflation.slop-lexicon.fix: Delete the adjective, or replace it with the number, benchmark, or feature list that backs it.
prose-inflation.slop-lexicon.name: Replace a marketing adjective with a measurable claim

prose-inflation.uncomparables.description: not comparable: … -- the adjective is already absolute; drop the intensifier
prose-inflation.uncomparables.fix: Delete the intensifier; the adjective already means the maximum.
prose-inflation.uncomparables.name: Drop the intensifier from an absolute

prose-inflation.vague-declarative.description: vague declarative: … -- name the specific thing
prose-inflation.vague-declarative.fix: Replace the significance claim with the specific thing it refers to.
prose-inflation.vague-declarative.name: Name the specific thing

prose-inflation.vague-quantifier.description: vague quantifier: … -- give the count, or name the cases
prose-inflation.vague-quantifier.fix: Supply the count, or name the cases.
prose-inflation.vague-quantifier.name: Give the count

prose-promotion.promotional-adjective-no.description: promotional adjective: … -- delete it, or give the measurement
prose-promotion.promotional-adjective-no.fix: Delete the adjective. If the claim matters, replace it with the number behind it.
prose-promotion.promotional-adjective-no.name: Cut the promotional adjective

prose-promotion.promotional-puffery.description: puffery: … -- replace with the fact that would justify it
prose-promotion.promotional-puffery.fix: Delete the phrase, or replace it with the number or fact behind it.
prose-promotion.promotional-puffery.name: Use neutral, specific language

prose-promotion.promotional-verbs.description: promotional verb: … -- use the direct verb
prose-promotion.promotional-verbs.fix: Use the plain verb: "showcase" is "show", "harness" is "use", "embark on" is "start", "foster" is "encourage" or "cause".
prose-promotion.promotional-verbs.name: Use the direct verb

prose-promotion.strategy-buzzwords.description: strategy buzzword: … -- describe the actual mechanism or advantage
prose-promotion.strategy-buzzwords.fix: Name the loop or the barrier, and what makes it hold.
prose-promotion.strategy-buzzwords.name: Describe the mechanism

prose-scope.code-change-prose-scope.description: Unrelated prose changed during a code edit is a scope defect. Keep only prose that directly explains or specifies changed code, unless the user explicitly requested the prose edit.
prose-scope.code-change-prose-scope.fix: Revert unrelated prose changes; retain directly related stale-comment corrections and explicitly requested prose edits.
prose-scope.code-change-prose-scope.name: Keep code-change prose scoped

prose-scope.epigram.description: epigram: … -- the section already made this point; cut the flourish
prose-scope.epigram.fix: Delete it; the paragraph or table above already carried the content.
prose-scope.epigram.name: Cut the closing flourish

prose-scope.formulaic-subject-verb-sloga.description: formulaic slogan: … -- title it with a noun phrase, or state one scoped fact
prose-scope.formulaic-subject-verb-sloga.fix: Name the section with a noun phrase, or state the one fact the two clauses gesture at.
prose-scope.formulaic-subject-verb-sloga.name: Replace a paired subject-verb slogan with a title

prose-scope.implementation-leak.description: implementation leak: … -- the reader cannot act on this; move it to the commit, ADR, or spec
prose-scope.implementation-leak.fix: Delete the measurement, or move it to a benchmarks page that carries its conditions and a reproduction command.
prose-scope.implementation-leak.name: Move a benchmark result out of the doc

prose-scope.rejected-alternative.description: rejected alternative: … -- state what it does; the decision belongs in an ADR, spec, or commit
prose-scope.rejected-alternative.fix: Cut to the behaviour; move the decision to an ADR, a spec, or the commit that made it.
prose-scope.rejected-alternative.name: Move the decision to an ADR, spec, or commit

prose-scope.unrequested-reassurance.description: unrequested reassurance: … -- state what it does, or say nothing
prose-scope.unrequested-reassurance.fix: Keep the positive statement alone, or delete the sentence -- a step that needs no setup has no setup step.
prose-scope.unrequested-reassurance.name: State the positive, or say nothing

ste-descriptive.information-not-gradual.description: Check that this paragraph introduces one idea at a time.
ste-descriptive.information-not-gradual.fix: Split the paragraph so each sentence adds one idea in reading order.
ste-descriptive.information-not-gradual.name: Give information gradually

ste-descriptive.missing-key-word-structu.description: Check that this paragraph repeats its key words instead of varying them.
ste-descriptive.missing-key-word-structu.fix: Repeat the key word from the previous sentence rather than substituting a synonym.
ste-descriptive.missing-key-word-structu.name: Use key words to structure the text

ste-descriptive.paragraph-has-multiple-t.description: Check that this paragraph carries one topic.
ste-descriptive.paragraph-has-multiple-t.fix: Split the paragraph at the topic change.
ste-descriptive.paragraph-has-multiple-t.name: Keep one topic per paragraph

ste-descriptive.paragraph-too-many-sente.description: This paragraph has {value} sentences. Use six or fewer.
ste-descriptive.paragraph-too-many-sente.name: Keep a paragraph to six sentences

ste-descriptive.paragraph-without-relate.description: Check that this paragraph opens with a topic sentence.
ste-descriptive.paragraph-without-relate.fix: Add a topic sentence, or move the unrelated sentence to its own paragraph.
ste-descriptive.paragraph-without-relate.name: Group related information in a paragraph

ste-descriptive.sentence-too-long-descri.description: This sentence has {value} words. Use twenty-five or fewer.
ste-descriptive.sentence-too-long-descri.fix: Split the sentence at a clause boundary.
ste-descriptive.sentence-too-long-descri.name: Keep an explanatory sentence to twenty-five words

ste-nouns.long-domain-term-without-short.description: Check that this long domain term is written in full once and then given a short form.
ste-nouns.long-domain-term-without-short.fix: Write the term in full once, then declare a short form or hyphenate the fixed unit.
ste-nouns.long-domain-term-without-short.name: Give a short form for a long domain term

ste-nouns.multiword-noun-too-long.description: This noun stack has {value} words. Use three or fewer.
ste-nouns.multiword-noun-too-long.fix: Break the stack with a preposition, or define a short form.
ste-nouns.multiword-noun-too-long.name: Keep a noun stack to three words

ste-practices.ambiguous-preposition-with.description: Check which of the three senses "with" carries here.
ste-practices.ambiguous-preposition-with.fix: Rewrite so the sense of "with" is explicit, or state the condition first.
ste-practices.ambiguous-preposition-with.name: Keep the instrument sense clear

ste-practices.false-friend-term.description: "…" reads differently to a non-native reader. Use "…".
ste-practices.false-friend-term.fix: Replace the word with the one that matches your intended sense.
ste-practices.false-friend-term.name: Avoid a false friend

ste-practices.gendered-or-exclusionary-l.fix: Replace the term with the inclusive alternative, unless it is an identifier.
ste-practices.gendered-or-exclusionary-l.name: Use inclusive language

ste-practices.inconsistent-wording-for-s.description: This step is worded two ways in one document ("…" and "{other}").
ste-practices.inconsistent-wording-for-s.fix: Pick one wording for the step and use it everywhere.
ste-practices.inconsistent-wording-for-s.name: Word the same step the same way

ste-practices.latin-abbreviation.fix: Replace the abbreviation with the English words, or delete the trailing list.
ste-practices.latin-abbreviation.name: Do not use a Latin abbreviation

ste-practices.phrasal-verb.fix: Replace the phrasal verb with the single verb.
ste-practices.phrasal-verb.name: Do not use a phrasal verb

ste-practices.possessive-form-unclear.description: Possessive "…" may be unclear. Consider "of the ...".
ste-practices.possessive-form-unclear.fix: Rewrite with "of the", or split the sentence.
ste-practices.possessive-form-unclear.name: Use the possessive only when it is clear

ste-practices.unclear-demonstrative-this.description: Bare demonstrative "…". Name the thing it refers to.
ste-practices.unclear-demonstrative-this.fix: Replace the demonstrative with the noun phrase it refers to.
ste-practices.unclear-demonstrative-this.name: Give the referent for a bare demonstrative

ste-practices.unclear-pronoun.description: Pronoun "…" may have more than one referent.
ste-practices.unclear-pronoun.fix: Replace the pronoun with the noun it refers to.
ste-practices.unclear-pronoun.name: Replace an unclear pronoun with the noun

ste-practices.word-sense-incorrect.description: Check that each word carries the sense the vocabulary records for it.
ste-practices.word-sense-incorrect.fix: Replace the word with one whose recorded sense matches your intent.
ste-practices.word-sense-incorrect.name: Use each word in its correct sense

ste-practices.word-swap-insufficient.description: Check whether this sentence needs a rewrite rather than a word swap.
ste-practices.word-swap-insufficient.fix: Restructure the sentence around a permitted verb, rather than swapping one word.
ste-practices.word-swap-insufficient.name: Rewrite the sentence when a word swap fails

ste-procedural.condition-after-command.description: The condition follows the command ("…"). Put the condition first.
ste-procedural.condition-after-command.fix: Move the condition clause to the front and follow it with a comma.
ste-procedural.condition-after-command.name: Put the condition before the command

ste-procedural.instruction-not-imperativ.description: This step is not in the imperative ("…").
ste-procedural.instruction-not-imperativ.fix: Rewrite the step as a direct command to the reader.
ste-procedural.instruction-not-imperativ.name: Write instructions in the imperative

ste-procedural.multiple-instructions-per.description: This step carries more than one instruction ("…").
ste-procedural.multiple-instructions-per.fix: Split the step so each sentence gives one instruction.
ste-procedural.multiple-instructions-per.name: Write one instruction per sentence

ste-procedural.note-gives-instruction.description: This note gives an instruction ("…"). A note only gives information.
ste-procedural.note-gives-instruction.fix: Move the instruction into a numbered step and leave only information in the note.
ste-procedural.note-gives-instruction.name: Keep notes free of instructions

ste-procedural.sentence-too-long-procedu.description: This instruction has {value} words. Use twenty or fewer.
ste-procedural.sentence-too-long-procedu.fix: Split the instruction into separate numbered steps.
ste-procedural.sentence-too-long-procedu.name: Keep an instruction to twenty words

ste-punctuation.colon-terminates-sentenc.description: The lead-in before the colon has {value} words. Use the sentence cap.
ste-punctuation.colon-terminates-sentenc.fix: Shorten the lead-in, or move detail into the list items.
ste-punctuation.colon-terminates-sentenc.name: Count a list lead-in as its own sentence

ste-punctuation.hyphen-group-too-long.description: This hyphen group joins more than three words ("…").
ste-punctuation.hyphen-group-too-long.fix: Break the group with a preposition, or register it as a domain term.
ste-punctuation.hyphen-group-too-long.name: Do not hyphenate more than three words

ste-punctuation.hyphen-missing-in-compou.fix: Join the two modifier words with a hyphen.
ste-punctuation.hyphen-missing-in-compou.name: Hyphenate a compound modifier before a noun

ste-punctuation.parentheses-misuse.description: Check that this parenthetical serves a listed purpose.
ste-punctuation.parentheses-misuse.fix: Promote the parenthetical to its own sentence, or delete it.
ste-punctuation.parentheses-misuse.name: Use parentheses only for the listed purposes

ste-punctuation.semicolon-used.description: The semicolon is not permitted. Write two sentences.
ste-punctuation.semicolon-used.fix: Replace the semicolon with a period and capitalize the next word.
ste-punctuation.semicolon-used.name: Do not use a semicolon

ste-safety.risk-level-word-missing-or-wr.description: Check that this block uses the risk word that matches its actual risk level.
ste-safety.risk-level-word-missing-or-wr.fix: Add the correct risk marker, or raise the existing marker to match the consequence.
ste-safety.risk-level-word-missing-or-wr.name: Mark the risk level with the right word

ste-safety.safety-block-does-not-start-w.description: This safety block does not open with a command or condition ("…").
ste-safety.safety-block-does-not-start-w.fix: Move the command or the condition to the first sentence of the block.
ste-safety.safety-block-does-not-start-w.name: Start a safety block with the command or the condition

ste-safety.safety-block-missing-conseque.description: This safety block gives no explanation of the risk or the result.
ste-safety.safety-block-missing-conseque.fix: Add a sentence that states what happens if the reader ignores the warning.
ste-safety.safety-block-missing-conseque.name: Explain the consequence

ste-sentences.complex-text-not-in-vertic.description: This sentence carries {value} coordinated items. Use a vertical list.
ste-sentences.complex-text-not-in-vertic.fix: Convert the coordinated series into a vertical list.
ste-sentences.complex-text-not-in-vertic.name: Use a vertical list for complex content

ste-sentences.missing-article-or-determi.name: Use an article or a demonstrative before a noun

ste-sentences.missing-connector-between-.description: Check whether these two sentences need a connecting word.
ste-sentences.missing-connector-between-.fix: Add a connecting word or phrase that names the relation.
ste-sentences.missing-connector-between-.name: Connect related sentences

ste-sentences.omitted-subject.description: Omitted subject "…". Name what is installed, configured, or ready.
ste-sentences.omitted-subject.name: Do not omit the subject after If, When, or Once

ste-sentences.sentence-not-short-or-clea.description: Check that this sentence carries one instruction or one topic.
ste-sentences.sentence-not-short-or-clea.fix: Split the sentence into one instruction or topic per sentence.
ste-sentences.sentence-not-short-or-clea.name: Write short and clear sentences

ste-sentences.vertical-list-item-punctua.fix: Capitalize each item, remove commas and semicolons, and end the last item with a period.
ste-sentences.vertical-list-item-punctua.name: Punctuate list items consistently

ste-sentences.vertical-list-lead-in-miss.description: The sentence before a vertical list must end with a colon.
ste-sentences.vertical-list-lead-in-miss.fix: Replace the period at the end of the lead-in with a colon.
ste-sentences.vertical-list-lead-in-miss.name: End the list lead-in with a colon

ste-verbs.auxiliary-stacking.description: Auxiliary stack "…". Give the action directly.
ste-verbs.auxiliary-stacking.fix: Rewrite as an imperative, or name the actor and use the active voice.
ste-verbs.auxiliary-stacking.name: Do not stack auxiliaries

ste-verbs.complex-tense.description: Complex verb construction "…". Use a simple present, past, or future tense.
ste-verbs.complex-tense.fix: Rewrite in the simple present, simple past, or simple future tense.
ste-verbs.complex-tense.name: Use simple tenses only

ste-verbs.gerund-outside-noun-use.description: Check that this -ing form works as a noun or as part of a noun, not as a verb.
ste-verbs.gerund-outside-noun-use.fix: Rewrite the clause with a finite verb, or split it into a separate sentence.
ste-verbs.gerund-outside-noun-use.name: Use an -ing form only as a noun or a noun modifier

ste-verbs.nominalized-action.fix: Replace the light verb and its noun with the single verb that names the action.
ste-verbs.nominalized-action.name: State an action with a verb

ste-verbs.passive-voice.description: Passive voice "…". Name the actor and use the active voice.
ste-verbs.passive-voice.fix: Name the actor as the subject, or rewrite as an imperative.
ste-verbs.passive-voice.name: Use the active voice

ste-verbs.past-participle-not-adjectival.description: Check that this past participle acts as an adjective, not as part of a verb.
ste-verbs.past-participle-not-adjectival.fix: Move the participle before the noun it describes, or rewrite in the active voice.
ste-verbs.past-participle-not-adjectival.name: Use a past participle only as an adjective

ste-verbs.verb-form-not-listed.description: "…" is not a listed form of "…".
ste-verbs.verb-form-not-listed.fix: Use a listed form of the verb.
ste-verbs.verb-form-not-listed.name: Use only listed verb forms

ste-words.approved-word-substitution.fix: Replace the flagged word with the listed replacement.
ste-words.approved-word-substitution.name: Use the controlled replacement word

ste-words.domain-noun-category-membershi.description: Check that each out-of-vocabulary noun belongs to a declared domain-noun category.
ste-words.domain-noun-category-membershi.fix: Register the term in a domain-noun category, or replace it with a vocabulary word.
ste-words.domain-noun-category-membershi.name: Confirm the domain noun belongs to a declared category

ste-words.domain-noun-not-organization-a.description: Check that this term is the one your project's glossary defines.
ste-words.domain-noun-not-organization-a.fix: Replace the term with the glossary term.
ste-words.domain-noun-not-organization-a.name: Use the domain term your project already uses

ste-words.domain-noun-too-long-or-unclea.description: Check that this new domain term is short and understandable.
ste-words.domain-noun-too-long-or-unclea.fix: Shorten the term to three words or fewer, or define it once and use a short form.
ste-words.domain-noun-too-long-or-unclea.name: Choose a short and clear domain term

ste-words.domain-verb-category-membershi.description: Check that this out-of-vocabulary verb is a declared domain verb used in its own context.
ste-words.domain-verb-category-membershi.fix: Rewrite with a vocabulary verb, or register the verb in a domain-verb category.
ste-words.domain-verb-category-membershi.name: Confirm the domain verb belongs to a declared category

ste-words.inconsistent-term-for-same-thi.description: This document calls the same thing "…" and "{other}".
ste-words.inconsistent-term-for-same-thi.fix: Pick one term and use it in every sentence.
ste-words.inconsistent-term-for-same-thi.name: Use one term per thing

ste-words.noun-used-as-verb.description: Do not use "…" as a verb. Use "…".
ste-words.noun-used-as-verb.fix: Rewrite with a verb, and keep the noun as a noun.
ste-words.noun-used-as-verb.name: Do not use a domain noun as a verb

ste-words.obligation-word-substitution.fix: Replace with "must" where the requirement is real. Where it is genuinely optional, say so plainly ("optional", "you can") rather than hedging the obligation word. In a document using RFC 2119 keywords, write them in capitals.
ste-words.obligation-word-substitution.name: Use one obligation word

ste-words.slang-or-jargon-term.description: "…" is slang or jargon. Use a plain term.
ste-words.slang-or-jargon-term.fix: Replace the slang term with a plain description of the behaviour.
ste-words.slang-or-jargon-term.name: Do not use slang or jargon as a domain term

ste-words.unapproved-word-not-a-domain-n.description: Check that this out-of-vocabulary word is a domain noun or part of one.
ste-words.unapproved-word-not-a-domain-n.fix: Register the domain noun, or replace the word.
ste-words.unapproved-word-not-a-domain-n.name: Allow an out-of-vocabulary word only as a domain noun

ste-words.verb-or-adjective-form-not-per.description: "…" is not a permitted form of "…".
ste-words.verb-or-adjective-form-not-per.fix: Use a listed form of the word, or rewrite the sentence.
ste-words.verb-or-adjective-form-not-per.name: Use only permitted word forms

ste-words.verb-used-as-noun.description: Do not use "…" as a noun. Use the noun form.
ste-words.verb-used-as-noun.fix: Replace the verb-as-noun with the noun form, or rewrite with the verb.
ste-words.verb-used-as-noun.name: Do not use a domain verb as a noun

ste-words.word-outside-controlled-vocabu.description: "…" is on this project's word blocklist.
ste-words.word-outside-controlled-vocabu.fix: Use the replacement the blocklist names, or rewrite the sentence.
ste-words.word-outside-controlled-vocabu.name: Do not use a word this project refuses

ste-words.word-used-in-wrong-part-of-spe.description: "…" is permitted as {allowed_pos} but not as {found_pos}.
ste-words.word-used-in-wrong-part-of-spe.fix: Rewrite so the word carries its permitted part of speech, or choose a different word.
ste-words.word-used-in-wrong-part-of-spe.name: Use the word only in its permitted part of speech

ste-words.word-used-outside-permitted-se.description: Check that each controlled word carries its permitted meaning.
ste-words.word-used-outside-permitted-se.fix: Replace the word with one whose permitted sense matches your intent.
ste-words.word-used-outside-permitted-se.name: Use the word only in its permitted sense
